caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mantel clock with a pointed, triangular top and four finials at each top corner. The clock case is primarily a reddish-brown wood, with two distinct sections: the upper section contains a large, round clock face with black Roman numerals and two black clock hands, enclosed by a glass door with a brass knob. The lower section features two rectangular panels, each bordered in blue, with intricate gold, yellow, and white decorative opaque designs resembling stylized feathers or foliage behind glass. The base of the clock is rectangular with four small round feet. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a small signature in the lower left corner reading “Frank S. Wilson.”
title: Shelf Clock
